name: Touched by Death
body:
Some part of you is steeped in death and it manifests in strange powers.

Benefit(s): You gain the following spell-like abilities, each usable once per day plus one additional time for every 4 character levels you possess: cause fear, ghost sound, and touch of fatigue. Your caster level for these abilities is equal to your character level. The save DC for these spell-like abilities is 10 + 1/2 your character level + the highest modifier among your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores.
